toggle-group.$description: Each variant is a surface role read from the family in scope; data-surface picks the family. The old presets map as Toggle's do (default → elevated; glass → glass + deep; stark → stark + glow; flat → flat + minimal; matte → neuro + solid). The kind owns its radius (the class map's rounded-md).
